plugins.name: claude-config-skills
plugins.description: General-purpose skills from this config, installable without cloning: claude-md-optimizer, unify-agents-md, project-documenter, technical-documenter, feature-documenter, raginclude-generator, model-registry. For version-manager, repo-doctor, update-code-map, and yt-transcript (which ship bundled tools), install repo-hygiene / docs-toolkit / yt-transcript from the Chameleon Labs marketplace (Chameleon-Labs-LLC/plugins) — or clone this repo and follow the README.
